standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherent sheaves on affines
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes the restriction of F to each standard affine as the tilde of a module N_i.

core_obligations: Make M = direct sum of the M_d a graded module over the polynomial ring via the twist multiplication isomorphisms.
Construct c: M-tilde to F on U_i by sending m/T_i^d to the unique m_i with m|_{U_i} = m_i tensor T_i^d; the overlap identity (T_i/T_j)^d m_i = m_j makes it global.
Injectivity: c(s) = 0 forces m|_{U_i} = 0, hence T_i^e m = 0, hence s = 0 in the localized module.
Surjectivity: given s on U_0, spread it to the U_i by localizing the N_i, clear denominators with a large power of T_0/T_i so the pieces glue to a global section of F(e + d).
proof_roadmap: Define c chartwise, verify the overlap identity, prove injectivity by torsion clearing, then run the denominator-clearing glueing for surjectivity.
difficulty_reason: Explicit section formula on the standard affines, injectivity by torsion clearing, surjectivity by a covering refinement over pairwise overlaps; only the well-definedness assembly is omitted.
